How to read

Overlay draws each method's cells in its own colour.
A vs B diff colours the cells of A by their partner cells in B:
matched – one-to-one; split – B splits it into 2+ cells; merged – B joins it with other A cells; only in A – B has no cell there.
Cell table has one row per ground-truth (Contour) cell. Each method shows its partner cell IDs, area, IoU and status (matched, split, merged, missed). Extra rows list cells that a method found where the ground truth has no cell. Click a row to see the cell on the slide.
Two cells are partners when they share at least 10% of the smaller cell's pixels. Outlines are rebuilt from each method's crop images.
